parties: Hexagon Nutrition Limited; Vikram Kelkar (Promoter & Managing Director)
headline: Hexagon Nutrition: Promoter MD Vikram Kelkar acquires 16,300 shares; Regulation 29(2) disclosure filed
sum: Vikram Kelkar, Promoter & Managing Director of Hexagon Nutrition Limited, acquired 16,300 equity shares, triggering mandatory disclosure under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011.
implication: Routine promoter acquisition filing; demonstrates SEBI Reg 29(2) disclosure compliance mechanics and the threshold-based reporting requirement for promoter insider transactions.
detail: On 19 Aug 2026, Hexagon Nutrition Limited intimated the National Stock Exchange of India (NSE) of a substantial acquisition by its Promoter and Managing Director, Mr. Vikram Kelkar, who acquired 16,300 equity shares in the company. The transaction triggered mandatory disclosure requirements under Regulation 29(2) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, which mandates disclosure when promoters or persons acting in concert acquire or dispose of shares exceeding specified thresholds. The intimation was filed via NSE's corporate disclosure system on 19 Aug 2026.
